verdicts.reason: A has a clear left-to-right banner structure: logo, a large headline in the left column, then date, chips and CTA in the middle, with the phone on the right. Its flaws are small and need fixing: '6 pm' is indented a few pixels from 'Saturday 21 June', the legal text is tiny and crammed under the CTA, and the placeholder box floats next to the phone. B has real collisions: the 'Reserve a spot' line sits on the bottom edge of the RSVP button, and the placeholder box overlaps the phone. B also indents the subtitle for no reason, packs the date, chips and CTA tightly under the headline, and crams the logo into the corner, so its hierarchy is weaker and the layout looks jammed.
